Fly a route of several stops: take off, fly to the next field, land, and carry on. Progress saves at every stop, so you can quit and resume later from here.

Xbox and PlayStation controller

Menu · Options
Pause menu
On the world map
Left stick spins the globe, LT / RT zoom, A selects the airport under the cross-hair (A again confirms), Y flies now, B goes back
In the menus
Left stick or D-pad moves the gold highlight, A selects, B goes back, LB / RB change tab, Y · Triangle jumps to the Start button

Gamepads work too: left stick pitch and roll, right stick rudder, right trigger throttle. Terrain is generated around the real coordinates, elevations and runway layouts of each airfield, so the lie of the land is invented but the airports are real.
